Social interaction rules (optional pack)

An optional rules pack for Mythastria. Off by default: the SRD 5.2.1 rule stays ("Indifferent is the default attitude of a monster"). Switch it on for a campaign in Remix Prep (Attitudes and morale). When it is on, each creature starts every encounter with the disposition below, unless the adventure or your prep says otherwise.

  1. Faction first. A faction written on the creature in the map or adventure, else a faction this pack lists it in.
  2. A social creature (Intelligence 4 or higher) takes its creature type's disposition from the table.
  3. Not social (Intelligence 3 or lower): instinct. A predator is Hostile, any other Indifferent; mindless Constructs, Oozes, Plants and Undead keep their type's Hostile. It can't be talked into anything; a Beast or Monstrosity can be coaxed with Wisdom (Animal Handling).
